scope: All supported visible user/assistant message and tool-call/result events through this fixed snapshot, in source order. Non-sensitive bodies are retained, not summarized. Sensitive events are represented by provenance-only omission entries. Original language is retained by explicit user authorization. This is a privacy-redacted visible transcript, not an unredacted runtime dump.
boundary: The export ends at the source snapshot hash. Subsequent export, inspection and publication actions are outside this fixed boundary.
selected_patch_scope: Selected actual English project-code tool submissions; workspace prefixes removed from headers. Source event hashes join the full bounded visible event index. Submitted proposals may fail or be superseded; final task source remains authoritative. This remains a disclosed redacted derivative.

legacy_event_index.scope: Earlier metadata-only index; the later visible transcript is the primary session export.
